name: Save topics and questions
description: Persists the generated interview topics and their questions for the caller's open interview, then advances it to the interview stage. Idempotent on retry.

inputFields.label: Topics
inputFields.description: The ordered list of interview topics, each with its ordered questions. Generate 4-6 topics with 3-6 questions each per the methodology skill.
inputFields.jsonSchema: {"type":"array","minItems":4,"maxItems":6,"items":{"type":"object","properties":{"order":{"type":"integer","description":"1-based topic order, most critical first"},"name":{"type":"string","description":"Topic name shown in bold to the interviewee"},"description":{"type":"string","description":"Optional one-line summary of what the topic covers"},"questions":{"type":"array","minItems":3,"maxItems":6,"items":{"type":"object","properties":{"order":{"type":"integer","description":"1-based question order within the topic"},"questionText":{"type":"string","description":"Verbatim question text, in the interview language, asked exactly as written"},"mandatory":{"type":"boolean","description":"Whether the question must be answered (default true)"}},"required":["order","questionText"]}}},"required":["order","name","questions"]}}
